name: list_hot_tablets
description:
Lists hot tablets in a Cloud Bigtable cluster.
Start time defaults to Now if it is unset, and end time defaults to Now - 24 hours if it is unset. The start time should be less than the end time, and the maximum allowed time range between start time and end time is 48 hours. Start time and end time should have values between Now and Now - 14 days.

clusterId.description: Required. The cluster ID within the instance (e.g., "my-cluster").

endTime.description: Optional. The end time to list hot tablets. End time defaults to Now - 24 hours if it is unset. The end time should be greater than the start time, and the maximum allowed time range between start time and end time is 48 hours. Start time and end time should have values between Now and Now - 14 days.

instanceId.description: Required. The instance ID within the project (e.g., "my-instance").

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of results per page.

pageToken.description: Optional. The value of `next_page_token` returned by a previous call.

startTime.description: Optional. The start time to list hot tablets. The hot tablets in the response will have start times between the requested start time and end time. Start time defaults to Now if it is unset. The start time should be less than the end time, and the maximum allowed time range between start time and end time is 48 hours. Start time and end time should have values between Now and Now - 14 days.
